[[Menethil Keep]] is the fort that dominates the port town of [[Menethil Harbor]]. It is currently led by [[Captain Stoutfist]], the commander of the Menethil militia. Besides several guards, it also holds a few additional [[quest giver]]s and a [[vendor]].
